scope: Projection of existing actual Java observations onto the currently exposed Rust Fit fields. No original/native execution or numerical regeneration.
source_observation_scope: Pinned original Circle constructors, detached original SlursBuilder.computeModel/computeImpacts and original SlurInfo.getCurve on identical actual native candidate point sequences. Saved original book supplies its actual Sheet Scale only. No image recognition, createInter/retrieveGlyph, SlurLinker, graph insertion or export is invoked.
source_builder_instrumentation: Unsafe allocates an otherwise uninitialized detached SlursBuilder, then original private Parameters(actualSheetScale) populates its params. The invoked methods use only params and supplied model/points; Curves construction (which would build Skeleton) is intentionally avoided. Not an ordinary lifecycle observation.
special_numeric_encoding: Original NaN/Infinity/-Infinity strings are retained unchanged; null remains absence.
finite_numeric_encoding: Roundtrip decimal strings of existing original JSON doubles, parsed with Rust str::parse::<f64>; no math recomputation and no dependence on serde_json float-parser features.
